head_coach.name: Murat Yakin
head_coach.play_style_summary: A highly structured and tactically disciplined defensive unit prioritizing compact central coverage and possession-oriented play building from the back, transitioning into attack with vertical passing and pacey wingers.

key_players.name: Johan Manzambi
key_players.performance_stats: Named the UEFA Europa League Young Player of the Season with SC Freiburg, showcasing excellent duel-winning abilities and tactical fluidity in the midfield.

key_players.name: Gregor Kobel
key_players.performance_stats: A premier Bundesliga shot-stopper for Borussia Dortmund and Switzerland's number one keeper, exhibiting outstanding reflex saves and aerial dominance.

key_players.name: Dan Ndoye
key_players.performance_stats: A highly athletic, pacey winger who completed a €40m transfer to Nottingham Forest, providing robust counter-attacking runs and direct threat in transitions.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Travel authorization review delaying his arrival to the national squad
